personal.name: Mahesh Namdev Khandebharad
personal.tagline: Building Technology. Sharing Knowledge. Creating Impact.
personal.bio: I am a passionate Computer Science Engineering student, Technical Trainer, and Student Leader dedicated to bridging the gap between hardware execution and cloud-native software architectures. My journey is built on continuous learning, public speaking, leading student placement cells, competing in national hackathons, and sharing technical knowledge with peers. From initial failures to key leadership positions and successful internships, I build software that creates real-world impact.

experiences.description: Leading cell operations to empower CS students with placement training, industrial seminars, and entrepreneurial mentoring. Organized workshops covering core technologies for 1000+ engineering students.
Conducting technical training modules on operating systems, basic office automation, network fundamentals, and databases. Taught over 500 students, helping them clear certifications successfully.
Assisted in cyber forensic investigations, analyzed compromised system logs, and built security audit scripts for infrastructure monitoring. Learned advanced digital forensics tools.
Managing network administration, hardware troubleshooting, operating system installs (Linux/Windows), and software configuration for various local clients on a freelance basis.
Curating technical content, designing campaigns, and managing growth strategies for technology education channels. Expanded organic reach by 40% across professional handles.
Editing educational tech content, tutorials, and product demo videos. Proficient in timeline editing, audio enhancement, transitions, and premium animation overlay edits.
Building custom dashboards, full-stack landing pages, and desktop helper utilities for international clients. Focused on clean code, responsive styles, and customer satisfaction.
